transformations_required.rule: Trim every source string; blank strings normalize to null. Preserve unmodified values under raw.
ticket_type upper case; state casefold canonical map; do not infer unknown state or type from ticket number.

Group by normalized number, missing number treated as separate row. Choose greatest parseable updated_at <= cutoff; invalid/missing/future timestamp ranks below any valid timestamp. Ties select lowest source row. If all candidates lack valid timestamp select lowest source row and retain anomalies. Do not merge cells across versions.
transformations_required.warning: Version selection is a provisional assumption, not confirmed user business rule. Both duplicate IDs are outside backlog here, so selection does not change these backlog KPI totals.

transformations_required.rule: Cutoff 2026-10-01 18:00:00 is naive in same clock reference as Excel. No timezone conversion or browser local-time dependence. Use deterministic calendar arithmetic. Future dates remain traceable, but exclude them only from date-dependent evaluations: future opened_at excludes age and stale; future updated_at excludes stale only; future sla_due has no KPI effect.

Canonical ticket by number; retain all 102 source rows in evidence, include only canonical row in metrics. Trim strings, blanks become null; state casefold map to Nuevo/En progreso/En espera/Resuelto/Cerrado. Unknown states excluded from backlog and flagged; unknown types retained as their upper-case value. Null type shown Sin tipo; missing group shown Sin grupo. Date anomalies never remove tickets from backlog or assignment/group metrics.

Apply filters ticket_type AND group_label to canonical tickets before every card/chart/detail computation. No filter means all; reset clears both. Dashboard operational detail shows filtered backlog records; source audit detail may show all 102 with canonical markers and explicit scope. Total source 102 is invariant and labelled source; filtered canonical ticket_count changes with filters. Options remain based on all canonical tickets including zero-backlog Proveedor Externo. Empty population counts=0, ages=null, denominators=0.

limitations: Snapshot current states do not reconstruct historical status changes at cutoff. All timestamps observed <= cutoff, but no event history exists.
No SLA KPI requested; sla_due profiled only.
Field assigned_to contains personal names from test export; retain in local evidence, do not expose unnecessarily.
Source selection and ancillary KPI population are explicitly proposed assumptions, not newly confirmed requirements.

assumptions.text: Operational stale, unassigned, age and by_group metrics use backlog population.
Unassigned means no individual responsible; missing group is separate. Age starts at opened_at.
T3 canonical selection latest valid updated_at, tie earliest row; all 102 rows preserved.
Missing opened_at makes stale non-evaluable because chronology cannot be validated; future timestamps treatment follows T4.
